resources.string: To turn the screen on when a call arrives, allow full screen notifications for DzCentrex on the next screen.
To ring even when the app is closed, DzCentrex must not be restricted by battery optimization. On the next screen, choose \"Allow\".
On this phone, enable \"Autostart\" for DzCentrex, otherwise calls may not arrive when the app is closed.
Scan the QR code of your extension to configure this app. Everything is set automatically.
The QR code is in your user area or is given by your administrator. You can also choose a screenshot or an image received by e-mail.
